title: 磁盘调度：FCFS / SSTF / SCAN / LOOK / C-SCAN / C-LOOK 的磁头移动距离
expected_output:
start head = 100, disk cylinders = 0..199
requests   = 55, 58, 39, 18, 90, 160, 150, 38, 184
FCFS   = 498
SSTF   = 248
SCAN   = 280  (sweeps to disk end 199)
LOOK   = 250  (turns at the last request)
C-SCAN = 388  (return trip not served)
C-LOOK = 322
LOOK saves SCAN's pointless trip to the disk end: 250 < 280
SSTF is shortest but starves far requests; C-SCAN equalizes wait time
